rows.label: tlk43310141_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Divine Beast warships are wonderful...
They really capture a man's dream!

rows.label: tlk43310141_01_msg0002
rows.name:
I volunteered for maintenance so I
could work on every last part of
Divine Beast warships.

rows.label: tlk43310141_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Invidian Divine Beast battleships
preserve the Beast's natural state.
That's the design principle.

rows.label: tlk43310141_01_msg0004
rows.name:
We mainly monitor the Beast's health
and watch for abnormalities in the
organic nanotubes that control it.

rows.label: tlk43310141_01_msg0005
rows.name:
I feel a little bad for the weaponized
Divine Beasts though. When war breaks
out, they get sent to the frontlines.

rows.label: tlk43310141_01_msg0006
rows.name:
Breaks my heart when they
come back and they're all
smashed up. It really gets me.
